old_usage.cumulative_time_definition: Sum of unique recorded per-paper PDF processing times and per-request times, including historical failed request. These are separate from run wall time and are not summed with wall time.

new_usage.token_accounting_note: Known response usage only; connection failures without a response may have unknown additional billed usage.
new_usage.accounting_note: Cumulative execution = full43 historical cumulative + newly executed requests including archived connection failure; current selected baseline excludes superseded capped successes and failures. Copied long-paper extraction counted once as reused. Tokens are known usage, not an upper bound on possible billed usage.
